label: Collection list
description: Lists the published entries of a collection — each entry's title, summary and picture, linked to its own address when the collection has one.

fields.name: collection
fields.label: Collection
fields.help: Which collection to list. Add your own collection ids to this section type's options as you declare them.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: How many entries
fields.help: The newest entries up to this many. At most 50.

fields.name: sort
fields.label: Order
fields.help: "collection" uses the order the collection itself declares (a blog's own date order); "newest" and "oldest" use when each entry was last edited.
